code.description: Editor whose lines keep their identity: {commit, file, base?, repo?, context?} from git, or {before, after}, or {lines, steps}; {x, y, w, size, title, say|at, focus, gutter}

ground.description: A full-frame GPU material behind the stage: {material: noise|sheen|halftone|grain|glass|chrome|gold|thermal|scanlines, colors, opacity, scale, speed, z}

elements.description: Native elements drawn after under, before actors — rect|circle|ellipse|line|path|poly|text|icon|image|video|group|particles|spotlight|shader|code|connector (camera: false pins one to the screen); see docs/scene-engine.md

camera.description: The stage camera: {x, y, zoom, rotate, z, keys: [{at|say, x, y, zoom, rotate, z, dur, ease}], focus: {z, aperture, keys}}

shutter.description: Motion-blur shutter, 0–1 of a frame (0.5 = 180°); 0 for none

samples.description: Time samples per frame for motion blur (default 8, at most 32)

motion.description: Motion preset for the stage: {preset, intensity}

z.description: under (default: the stage is the picture) or over the block content

view.description: "auto" (fit the drawing into the content area, up to 2×), [width, height] author units fitted below the header, a camera rect [x, y, width, height] framed across the whole frame, or omit for frame pixels (1920×1080 landscape)

viewFrom.description: Camera rect the view travels from (set automatically between world beats)

viewAt.description: Scene seconds the camera move starts (default 0)

viewDrift.description: After arriving, the camera keeps easing in by this fraction of the view (worlds default 0.03)

viewTall.description: Camera rect for tall (vertical) frames; otherwise the view is re-framed on the beat’s own foreground

world.description: Name shared by consecutive canvas beats that form one continuous drawing: each inherits what came before, cuts invisibly, and the camera travels between their views

elements.description: [{type: rect|circle|ellipse|line|path|poly|text|icon|image|group|meter|spotlight|particles|solid, geometry, fill, stroke, width, enter, say|at, dur, keys, loop, along, exit, exitSay|exitAt, z, blur, shine, tilt, material, mosaic, print}] (≤ 600) — see docs/canvas.md

stagger.description: Seconds between top-level elements without a cue (0–3)

rough.description: Hand-drawn strokes for every shape: true or {amount, passes, boil, fill: hachure|solid, gap} (an element can set rough: false)

mosaic.description: Lay every shape in tiles: true or {tile, gap, jitter, flow: rows|rings|contour, style: tesserae|pixel|stitch, outline, build: sweep|radial|random, shade, shine, grout, axis} (an element can set mosaic: false)

print.description: Print every shape: benday|halftone|engraving|newsprint|letterpress or {screen: dots|lines|none, cell, angle, tone, axis, register: [dx, dy], wear, ink} (an element can set print: false)

dolly.description: Fly the camera through depth: keys [{say|at, z, dur, ease}]. Elements with z are drawn in perspective; the camera passes them as its z reaches theirs

focus.description: Depth of field for elements with z: {z (the focus plane), aperture 0–3 (1 natural), keys [{say|at, z, dur}] for a rack focus}

chart.description: A chart drawn as canvas shapes with stable ids, so consecutive canvas charts morph into each other (a number into its bar, a stacked bar into bars): {kind: bars|stack|number, values: [{label, value, highlight, id}], box: [x, y, w, h], max, prefix, suffix, decimals, id, note: {text, to, say}} (the note replaces a heading: an annotation on the stressed word)

kpi.description: Editable native dimensional KPI: {form: pedestal|comparison|rail|seesaw|stack, label, unit?, value?, values?:[{label,value}], total?, domain?:[0,max], prefix?, suffix?, decimals?:0–3, motion?:none|reveal|stagger|emphasis|{preset,duration,stagger}, focus?, source?}. Comparison front heights share one zero-based scale; rail and stack lengths use an explicit total. Seesaw has two comparable values and qualitative tilt. Seesaw/stack require a unit. Every form needs an exact visible source. See docs/kpi-direction.md.

sourceElement.description: Id of a top-level static native text element used as the visible source instead of the automatic footer. Requires storyboard sources, at:0, enter:none, size >=28, opaque ink fill, no effects/exits/keys/transforms. Frame audit still verifies bounds and overlap.

sourceSize.description: Canvas source font size, 14–72 px; reserves a three-line footer when set.

plot.description: Sourced multiseries line plot: {title, x:{type:linear|date,label,domain,ticks,...}, y:{type:linear|log,label,domain,ticks,...}, series:[{id,label,values:[{x,y}]}], asOf, source?, motion?:none|{at,duration}, annotation?}. Dates preserve elapsed spacing, null y leaves a gap, all series share explicit scales and a linear reveal clock. See docs/quantitative-plots.md.

bars.description: Signed editorial bar chart: {title, unit, values:[{label, value, highlight?}], domain:[min≤0, max≥0], ticks, decimals?, prefix?, suffix?, orientation?: vertical|horizontal, reference?: {value, label}, colors?: sign|single, asOf, source?, motion?: none|{at,duration}}. Bars grow from zero in order; negative values take the negative colour. See docs/bars.md.

bridge.description: Metric bridge (waterfall): {title, unit, start:{label, value}, steps:[1–10 {label, value} drivers or {label, total:true} subtotals, each with say?], end:{label, value, say?}, domain:[min≤0, max≥0], ticks, decimals?, prefix?, suffix?, good?: up|down, orientation?: auto|vertical|horizontal, asOf, source?, motion?: none|{at,duration}}. Totals stand on zero; drivers float from the running total and must reconcile to end exactly (add an explicit Other step rather than hide a gap); say cues a driver to its spoken word. See docs/bridge.md.

cast.description: A cast of objects that persists across consecutive canvas beats and re-forms as the idea develops, instead of a new card per line: {look?: tiles|drawn|print (first beat), objects:[1–16 {id, icon|word|shape: doc|bubble|phone|card|person|ticket|box, color, label?, size?, float?, enter?: pop|drop|rise|left|right|fade|none}] (declared in the first cast beat; later beats may add more), formations:[1–12 {form: scatter|line|row|column|ring|cluster|hero|swap|wave|merge|split|travel|mark|camera|fill|emerge|exit, say|at, ids?, hero?, word?, on?, beside?, out?, in?, by?, into?, from?, via?, trail?, mark?: circle|underline|cross|arrow, to?, color?, zoom?, thread?, center?, spread?, scale?, dur?, stagger?, ease?}]}. merge folds ids into one object (into) and split bursts them back out of one (from); travel sends ids along a curved route (via waypoints) to another object (to) or a point, a pen trail sketching ahead; camera zooms the whole cast (carried across cuts); fill grows one object into the frame so the next scene of any block plays on its colour (the job sets the tone of that scene and the cuts), and emerge brings it back in a later cast beat. Each beat starts where the last one left every object, so consecutive cast beats cut invisibly (transition cut, camera still). hero brings one forward and quiets the rest; swap turns one object into another in place, with by naming what causes it; wave runs through a sequence where it stands; mark draws a pen mark on objects (an arrow to others); exit sends objects off-frame. drawn is pen on paper, print a two-colour press. Positions come from the frame and stay title-safe, so one storyboard serves landscape and vertical. See docs/cast.md.

multiples.description: Small multiples: {title, unit, x, y (one shared scale, as plot), series:[2–9 {id,label,values:[{x,y}]}], highlight?: id, asOf, source?, motion?}. One small line per series in a grid; ticks on the outer edges; the highlighted panel takes accent2 and the others recede. See docs/small-multiples.md.

distribution.description: Editorial histogram: {title, unit, observations:[number|null], edges:[2–12 equal bins], threshold:{value, relation: lt|lte|gt|gte, label}, marker?:{value, label}, prefix?, suffix?, decimals?, tone?: negative|highlight, asOf, source?, motion?}. Counts sit on the bars; the threshold line states how many outcomes qualify. See docs/distribution-charts.md.

stat.description: A headline figure: {kicker?, value, decimals?, prefix?, suffix?, label, change?: {value, decimals?, suffix?, context, good?: up|down|neutral}, count?, asOf, source?, motion?}. The value counts up natively; the change line is green or red by whether a rise is good news for this measure. See docs/stat.md.

teaching.description: Editable pause/answer/explanation: {form:choice|gap, phase:question|answer, prompt, explanation, layout?:full|split, motion?:fade|none, revealAt?, explainAt?, source?}. Choice uses options:[2–3 strings] and correctIndex; gap uses before, answer and optional after. Use separate beats for reading and answer holds. Split reserves landscape right-half imagery. See docs/teaching-sequences.md.

sketch.description: A library sketch drawn under any elements, redrawn for this frame (clearframe sketch lists them); its camera (view, dolly, focus) applies unless the beat sets its own

diagram.description: Native system diagram whose components keep their identity while the story changes it: {direction?:auto|horizontal|vertical, area?:[x,y,w,h], nodes:[{id,label,kind?:service|database|user|queue|state|external,status?:neutral|active|added|removed|error,x?,y?,replaces?,at?|say?,exitAt?|exitSay?}], edges:[{id?,from,to,label?,status?,style?:solid|dashed,flow?,at?|say?}], steps?:[{at|say, add|remove|replace+with|set:{id:status}|send:[node ids] (+label, dur)}], groups?:[{id,label,nodes}]}. Up to 8 nodes, laid out in ranks along the edges; connectors wait for both ends, leave with removed components and route around others. Shared ids morph across consecutive canvas beats. clearframe sketch architecture|component-change|state-machine prints a starting diagram. See docs/system-diagrams.md.

sketchText.description: Replacement words for a sketch’s placeholder type: {"TITLE": "Your words"}

sketchSay.description: Spoken words for a sketch’s named moments, so they land on the voice: {"FIRST": "logs"} (each sketch’s use lists its cues)

seed.description: Varies a sketch’s seeded layout (buildings, ridges, swell)

plates.description: A generated depth plate set staged in depth: the id of an image asset declared with layers: true (its far, mid and near layers at z 6, 1.2 and -0.35), under any elements; adds a slow dolly unless the beat sets a camera
